nodes.summary: The set of crossing probabilities, for `n ≥ n₀` and all translates, of the long direction of `⌊ρn⌋ × n` and `n × ⌊ρn⌋` rectangles.

nodes.summary: The box-crossing property with aspect ratio `ρ > 1`: for some `n₀`, the probabilities of crossing all translates of `⌊ρn⌋ × n` rectangles in the long direction, `n ≥ n₀`, are bounded below by a positive constant.

nodes.summary: A finite measure on configurations is positively associated if `μ(A) μ(B) ≤ μ(A ∩ B) μ(univ)` for all measurable increasing events `A`, `B`. The total-mass factor makes the Harris--FKG inequality invariant under finite scaling.
nodes.title: Positively associated measure

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.label: statement formalized
